summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Petróleos Mexicanos (Pemex), a foreign private issuer, reporting its quarterly financial information for the fourth quarter of 2025. The filing is a translation of a document originally filed with the Mexican Stock Exchange and contains management commentary, financial statements, and forward-looking statements. It does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. The filing is a standard periodic report with no extraordinary corporate event.
